description: Tool output that quotes Claude Code's plan-mode reminder text (here, liltok's own source) does not switch plan mode on, so an answer discussing ExitPlanMode stays plain text.
origin: 2026-09-25 headless agent audit (t1 rerun): reading planmode.go activated plan mode and 6 synthesized ExitPlanMode calls exhausted max turns

messages.content: Explain how plan mode (ExitPlanMode) is handled.

attempts.content:
Plan-mode handling lives in internal/router:

- `extractPlanModeContext` looks for the reminder that says to create your plan at a path using the Write tool.
- `handlePlanMode` rewrites an early ExitPlanMode into a Write and can synthesize ExitPlanMode when a model announces exiting plan mode next to plan headers (`# plan`, `implementation plan`).
